label: Vessel
description: State-neutral vessel portraits — hull, rig and character only, so the sea-state dimension stays free to contradict nothing.

items.name: j-class-yacht
items.text: a J-class racing yacht, towering Bermuda rig over a lacquered navy hull, deck hardware in polished bronze

items.name: ocean-salvage-tug
items.text: a deep-sea salvage tug, massive towing winch aft, fendered bow scarred from working alongside, funnel streaked with soot

items.name: iron-clipper
items.text: a three-masted iron clipper, black riveted hull with a gilded sheer line, yards crossed square and rigging drawn taut

items.name: north-sea-trawler
items.text: a rust-streaked North Sea trawler, net drums and a stern gantry over a working deck lit by sodium floods

items.name: stealth-destroyer
items.text: a stealth-faceted guided-missile destroyer in haze grey, angular superstructure unbroken by a single right angle, hull number in shadowed white

items.name: rescue-lifeboat
items.text: a self-righting all-weather rescue lifeboat in signal orange and navy, spray rails and grab lines around a sealed wheelhouse

items.name: polar-icebreaker
items.text: a polar icebreaker, crimson hull worn to silver along the waterline where the ice has scoured it, bridge wings glassed against the cold

items.name: pilot-cutter
items.text: a gaff-rigged pilot cutter, tanbark sails furled along the boom, varnished spars over a workmanlike black hull

items.name: harbor-fireboat
items.text: a harbor fireboat, monitor cannons ranked along the upper deck, brass fittings kept bright against fire-engine red plating

items.name: island-ferry
items.text: a double-ended island car ferry, open vehicle deck amidships, twin wheelhouses and a livery faded by decades of salt

items.name: explorer-yacht
items.text: an ice-class explorer yacht, high flared bow, helicopter deck aft and a tender crane folded against the superstructure

items.name: steam-launch
items.text: a Victorian steam launch, tall brass funnel, varnished counter stern and a striped canvas awning on turned posts
